page.layout: One printed page, left, with a paragraph of text and a heading below it. Right of the scan is a narrow, cropped strip of the facing page's text, mostly illegible.

main_text.p: Exclamatio maximi medicorum : Ὁ βίος βραχύς, ἡ δὲ τέχνη μακρή, cuius in sequenti Carmine fit mentio, extat primo Aphorismorum : meminitque Seneca in-itio De brevitate vitæ.
main_text.head: PETRI

page.notes: The Greek line is printed in a larger, bold-looking face; the accents are read from the scan and may be imperfect. The right-hand strip is the cropped facing page: fragments such as "Carmen de", "dicis", "à Græ", "Ongu", "De medi", "Nes" are the only legible pieces, and the rest is illegible. "PETRI" is a bold spaced-caps line of uncertain status; it may be the opening of a longer heading, a running name, or a signature-like word. The page number "6" is a small printed numeral at the top left and may be a mark rather than a printed folio.
